packageRules.description: packages/api-client pins TypeScript 6 for its generator, which crashes on 7 (CLAUDE.md). CI never runs the generator, so a bump would pass every check and break the next regeneration.

pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides js-yaml@4.2.0 to ^4.3.2 for two advisories, because @hey-api/json-schema-ref-parser (1.4.4, still the latest on 2026-10-03) pins 4.2.0 exactly. The override exists to stay on the major its parent expects; lifting it to 5 would force a breaking release under a package written for 4. Drop this rule together with the override once the parent bumps.
